field.pathsHelp: One per line, as a full address or a path starting with /, on this site only. The plugin already refreshes automatically when a player changes textures or is renamed and when a texture is deleted; use this to refresh anything it missed.

refresh.queued: Queued {count, plural, one {# address} other {# addresses}}. Failed refreshes are retried automatically; jobs that keep failing are shown on the plugins page.

error.invalidPaths: An address is malformed or not on this site. At most 1000 at a time.

provider.label: CDN provider
provider.help: Whose CDN this site sits behind.

baseUrl.label: Site address on the CDN
baseUrl.help: Fill this in when the CDN domain differs from the site address, e.g. https://cdn.example.com. Leave empty to use the site address.

accessKeyId.label: Key ID
accessKeyId.help: Your Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID, Tencent Cloud SecretId, or the application (client) ID of an Azure app registration.

accessKeySecret.label: Key secret
accessKeySecret.help: Your Alibaba Cloud AccessKey Secret, Tencent Cloud SecretKey, or the Azure app's client secret. Permission to refresh the cache is all it needs.

azureTenantId.label: Azure tenant ID
azureTenantId.help: Only needed for Azure Front Door, as are the fields below.

plugin.name: CDN cache refresh
plugin.description: When the site sits behind a CDN, refreshes the affected addresses after a player changes textures, is renamed or deleted, and after a texture is deleted. Supports Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud and Azure Front Door.
